```{r switches}
RUN_VPC           <- TRUE    # Visual Predictive Check (mrgsolve + tidyvpc)

USE_SCM_FINAL     <- TRUE    # report the stage-2 SCM final model when one was saved
SHOW_BOOTSTRAP    <- TRUE    # bootstrap section, when stage 2 saved one

VPC_NSIM          <- 500     # number of simulated replicates for the VPC
VPC_LOG_YMIN      <- NULL    # Expected: NULL for automatic positive limit, or a positive concentration.

SEX_MALE_CODE     <- NULL     # Expected: source-data code for male.

```{r load-estimates, include=FALSE}
pmx_input <- function(nm, what = "report input", required = TRUE) {
  if(grepl("_data[.]csv$",nm) && nzchar(Sys.getenv("PMX_DATA",""))) return(Sys.getenv("PMX_DATA"))
  cand <- c(file.path("02_html", nm), nm, file.path("..", "02_html", nm), file.path("..", nm))
  hit <- cand[file.exists(cand)]
  if (length(hit)) return(hit[1])
  if (required) stop(what, " not found: ", nm,
                     "\n  looked in: ", paste(unique(cand), collapse = ", "),
                     "\n  stage 2 (s2_freeze.R) writes <fam>_estimates.zip and <fam>_scm_final.zip",
                     " into 02_html/; the model .cpp files and the dataset live beside it",
                     call. = FALSE)
  NA_character_
}
SCM_FINAL <- pmx_input("ppk_scm_final.zip", "stage-2 SCM fit archive", required = FALSE)
use_scm <- USE_SCM_FINAL && !is.na(SCM_FINAL)
fit <- nlmixr2save::loadFit(sub("\\.zip$", "", if (use_scm) SCM_FINAL else
  pmx_input("ppk_estimates.zip", "stage-2 base fit archive")))
CPP_SIM <- pmx_input("final_model.cpp", "mrgsolve translation of the final model")
CPP_EBE <- pmx_input("ppk_ebe.cpp", "EBE exposure simulator")
# S2 simulator sources are immutable gate artifacts. Rendering updates private copies.
private_simulator <- function(path) {
  destination <- tempfile("pmx_sim_",fileext=".cpp")
  if(!file.copy(path,destination)) stop("Cannot stage frozen simulator")
  destination
}
CPP_SIM <- private_simulator(CPP_SIM)
CPP_EBE <- private_simulator(CPP_EBE)

fixef_clean <- local({
  fe  <- fixef(fit)
  nm  <- names(fe)
  ini <- tryCatch(as.data.frame(fit$iniDf), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(ini)) for (k in seq_along(nm)) {
    hit <- match(nm[k], ini$name)
    if (is.na(hit)) hit <- match(sub("^t\\.", "", nm[k]), ini$name)
    if (!is.na(hit) && grepl("THETA", ini$label[hit]))
      nm[k] <- sub("\\s*\\[[^]]*\\]\\s*$", "", sub("\\s*\\(.*\\)\\s*$", "", trimws(sub("^.*THETA\\([0-9]+\\)", "", ini$label[hit]))))
  }
  stats::setNames(as.numeric(fe), nm)
})

frozen_path <- pmx_input("artifacts/s2/final.rds","frozen SCM record",required=FALSE)
frozen_search <- if(!is.na(frozen_path)) readRDS(frozen_path)$search else NULL
scm_cov <- unique(toupper(c(tryCatch(as.character(fit$muRefCovariateDataFrame$covariate),error=function(e) character()),
  unlist(lapply(frozen_search$added,function(group) vapply(group,function(e) e$cov,""))))))
SCM_CPP_MAP <- c(vc = "VC", cl = "CL")

dat <- tryCatch(as.data.frame(fit$origData), error = function(e) NULL)
if (is.null(dat) || !nrow(dat))
  stop("stage 3: the saved fit carries no origData - re-run stage 2")
id_col <- if ("ID" %in% names(dat)) "ID" else "id"

pmx_shared_src <- function(f) {
  tk <- if (exists(".cpu_path")) dirname(dirname(.cpu_path)) else ""
  dirs <- c(if (nzchar(tk)) file.path(tk, "analyses_template", "_shared"),
            file.path(Sys.getenv("PMX_TOOLKIT"), "analyses_template", "_shared"),
            ".pmx/pmx_workspace/analyses_template/_shared",
            "../.pmx/pmx_workspace/analyses_template/_shared",
            "../../.pmx/pmx_workspace/analyses_template/_shared",
            "analyses_template/_shared", "../../analyses_template/_shared",
            "../analyses_template/_shared", "_shared", "../_shared")
  cand <- unique(file.path(dirs[nzchar(dirs)], f))
  hit <- cand[file.exists(cand)]
  if (!length(hit)) stop("PMX_REPORT_SHARED_MISSING: ", f,
                         " not found; the toolkit that supplied cpu_budget.R must also carry analyses_template/_shared")
  hit[1]
}
source(pmx_shared_src("report_aug.R"))
.report_ctl <- if (!is.null(frozen_search$ctl)) frozen_search$ctl else {
  p <- pmx_input("artifacts/s2/final_fitted.ctl", "frozen control stream", required = FALSE)
  if (is.na(p)) character() else readLines(p, warn = FALSE)
}
est_aug <- pmx_fit_natural(pmx_est_aug(fit, CPP_SIM, fixed=fixef_clean), .report_ctl)

est <- list(
  fixef      = fixef_clean,
  aug        = est_aug,
  parFixedDf = as.data.frame(fit$parFixedDf),
  iniDf      = as.data.frame(fit$iniDf),
  cov        = tryCatch(as.matrix(fit$cov), error = function(e) NULL),
  eta        = local({
    e <- tryCatch(as.data.frame(fit$eta), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(e) || !nrow(e)) e <- tryCatch(as.data.frame(fit$ranef), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(e) || !nrow(e)) return(NULL)
    names(e) <- toupper(names(e))
    e
  }),
  objf       = tryCatch(fit$objf, error = function(e) NA_real_),
  aic        = tryCatch(AIC(fit), error = function(e) NA_real_),
  bic        = tryCatch(BIC(fit), error = function(e) NA_real_),
  loglik     = tryCatch(as.numeric(logLik(fit)), error = function(e) NA_real_),
  message    = tryCatch(as.character(fit$message), error = function(e) NULL),
  covMethod  = tryCatch(as.character(unlist(fit$covMethod)), error = function(e) NULL),
  runInfo    = tryCatch(as.character(unlist(fit$runInfo)), error = function(e) character(0)),
  n_subj     = length(unique(dat[[id_col]])),
  n_obs      = sum(dat$evid == 0),
  n_dose     = sum(dat$evid == 1)
)

observation_aug <- function(d) {
  if("EVID" %in% names(d)) d <- d[!is.na(d$EVID) & d$EVID==0,,drop=FALSE]
  if("MDV" %in% names(d)) d <- d[!is.na(d$MDV) & d$MDV==0,,drop=FALSE]
  d
}
unique_prediction <- function(d,key) {
  if(!nrow(d)) return(d)
  d <- distinct(d)
  if(anyDuplicated(d[,key,drop=FALSE])) stop("Ambiguous predictions at duplicate ID/time/endpoint; provide record-level matching")
  d
}
sample_subjects <- function(x,n=9L) {
  x <- unique(x[!is.na(x)])
  if(!length(x)) return(x)
  x[sample.int(length(x),min(n,length(x)))]
}

dose_fct <- function(x) {
  u <- unique(as.character(x))
  n <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sub("^\\s*([0-9.]+).*$", "\\1", u)))
  factor(as.character(x), levels = if (all(!is.na(n))) u[order(n)] else sort(u))
}

vpc_panels <- function(p, ylab) {
  pmx_fit_vpc_panels(p,ylab,log_ymin=VPC_LOG_YMIN)
}

prof_panels <- function(prof, ylab) {
  floor_lo <- min(prof$Mean[prof$Mean > 0], na.rm = TRUE) / 2
  prof <- prof %>%
    mutate(lo = pmax(Mean - SD, floor_lo), hi = Mean + SD)
  prof <- prof %>% mutate(DOSE = dose_fct(DOSE))
  p <- ggplot(prof, aes(TIME, Mean, colour = DOSE)) +
    geom_line() + geom_point(size = 1.6) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), width = 0.6, alpha = 0.5) +
    labs(x = "Time (h)", y = ylab, colour = "Dose") + theme_bw()
  gridExtra::grid.arrange(
    p + labs(y = paste0(ylab, " (linear scale)")),
    p + scale_y_log10() + labs(y = paste0(ylab, " (log scale)")),
    nrow = 1)
}

```{r read-data}
df <- read.csv(pmx_input("ppk_data.csv", "analysis dataset"), na.strings = ".")
df$DV <- pmx_observed_dv(df, .report_ctl)
obs <- df %>% filter(EVID == 0)
dose_rec <- df %>% filter(EVID == 1)

if(!"BW" %in% names(df) && "WTBL" %in% names(df)) df$BW <- df$WTBL
for(v in c("AGE","BW","BMI","ALB","CRCL","SEX","RACE")) if(!v %in% names(df)) df[[v]] <- NA_real_
if(!"DOSE" %in% names(df)) df$DOSE <- "All regimens"
if(!"ADY" %in% names(df)) df$ADY <- "All records"
cov_tab <- df %>% distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

summary_tab <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("Subjects", "Total records", "Observations", "Dosing records",
             "Dose groups (mg)", "Subjects per dose group", "Cycles",
             "Median BW (kg)", "% Female"),
  Value = c(
    nrow(cov_tab),
    nrow(df),
    nrow(obs),
    nrow(dose_rec),
    paste(sort(unique(cov_tab$DOSE)), collapse = ", "),
    paste(sprintf("%s: n=%d", names(table(cov_tab$DOSE)),
                  as.integer(table(cov_tab$DOSE))), collapse = "; "),
    length(unique(df$ADY)),
    round(median(cov_tab$BW, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    pmx_fit_percent_female(cov_tab$SEX,SEX_FEMALE_CODE,SEX_MALE_CODE)
  )
)
kable(summary_tab, caption = "Dataset Summary", align = "lc")
```

```{r cov-cor, fig.width=7, fig.height=6, fig.cap="Pearson correlation between continuous covariates"}
cc <- cov_tab %>% select(AGE, BW, BMI, ALB, CRCL)
cc <- cc[,vapply(cc,function(x) sum(is.finite(x))>=3L && length(unique(x[is.finite(x)]))>1L,TRUE),drop=FALSE]
if(ncol(cc)>=2L) {
cm <- cor(cc, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
ggplot(as.data.frame(as.table(cm)), aes(Var1, Var2, fill = Freq)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", Freq)), size = 3.2) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166ac", mid = "white", high = "#b2182b",
                       midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1), name = "r") +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_bw() + theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
}

```{r screen-history, results='asis'}
screen_file <- pmx_input(file.path("01_screen","ladder_table.csv"),required=FALSE)
if(is.null(screen_file)) screen_file <- pmx_input("ladder_table.csv",required=FALSE)
if(!is.null(screen_file) && length(screen_file) && file.exists(screen_file)) {
  h <- read.csv(screen_file,stringsAsFactors=FALSE,check.names=FALSE)
  if(nrow(h)) {
    error <- as.character(h$error);error[is.na(error)] <- ""
    status <- if("status" %in% names(h)) h$status else ifelse(is.finite(h$bic) & !nzchar(error),"completed","not completed")
    show <- data.frame(Round=if("round_id" %in% names(h)) substr(h$round_id,1,8) else "legacy",
      Candidate=basename(h$model),OFV=round(h$ofv,2),BIC=round(h$bic,2),
      `BIC definition`=if("bic_definition" %in% names(h)) ifelse(is.na(h$bic_definition) | !nzchar(h$bic_definition),"legacy/unknown",h$bic_definition) else "legacy/unknown",
      Selected=if("selected" %in% names(h)) ifelse(h$selected,"Yes","") else "",
      Status=status,Reason=error,check.names=FALSE)
    print(kable(show,caption="Candidate model screening history for base model selection",row.names=FALSE))
    cat("\nBIC rankings apply within a screening round on the same data and fitting settings. Legacy/unknown BIC conventions must not be compared with native likelihood BIC. Failed, cancelled and unstarted slots have no estimates.\n")
  }
}
```

## 3.1 Bootstrap Confidence Intervals

```{r bootstrap-report, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
if (SHOW_BOOTSTRAP && file.exists("ppk_bootstrap.zip")) {
  fit_boot <- nlmixr2save::loadFit("ppk_bootstrap")
  bs  <- lapply(fit_boot$bootSummary$parFixedDf, as.data.frame)
  lvl <- if (is.null(fit_boot$bootCI)) 0.95 else fit_boot$bootCI
  boot_tab <- data.frame(
    Parameter       = sub("^t\\.", "", rownames(bs$mean)),
    Estimate        = bs$mean[["Back-transformed"]],
    Lower           = bs$confLower[["Back-transformed"]],
    Upper           = bs$confUpper[["Back-transformed"]],
    `%RSE`          = 100 * bs$stdDev$Estimate / bs$mean$Estimate,
    check.names = FALSE, row.names = NULL)
  print(kable(boot_tab, digits = 4,
              caption = sprintf("Bootstrap percentile CI (%d replicates, %.0f %% level)",
                                fit_boot$bootSummary$nboot, 100 * lvl),
              col.names = c("Parameter", "Estimate", sprintf("%.0f%% CI lower", 100 * lvl),
                            sprintf("%.0f%% CI upper", 100 * lvl), "%RSE")))
  print(nlmixr2extra::bootplot(fit_boot))
} else {
  cat("Stage 2 was run without the bootstrap (RUN_BOOTSTRAP = FALSE).\n")
}
```

```{r scm-report}
if (SHOW_SCM) {
  frozen_record <- pmx_input("artifacts/s2/final.rds", "frozen SCM record", required = FALSE)
  rec <- if (!is.na(frozen_record)) readRDS(frozen_record)$search$rec else NULL
  if (is.null(rec)) {
    legacy_record <- pmx_input("ppk_scm_record.csv", "SCM record", required = FALSE)
    if (!is.na(legacy_record)) rec <- read.csv(legacy_record, check.names = FALSE)
  }
  if (!is.null(rec) && nrow(rec)) {
    fields <- if ("Model" %in% names(rec))
      c("Step", "Model", "BIC", "Estimate", "Decision") else
      c("step", "searchType", "covar", "var", "objf", "deltObjf",
        "AIC", "BIC", "qchisqr", "pchisqr", "included")
    display <- pmx_fit_scm_display(rec[, intersect(fields, names(rec)), drop = FALSE])
    display[] <- lapply(display, function(x) {
      if (anyNA(x)) { x <- as.character(x); x[is.na(x)] <- "" }
      x
    })
    print(kable(display, digits = 4,
                caption = "Covariate search run record (forward and backward steps)"))
    if ("Decision" %in% names(rec) && any(rec$Decision == "Fit failed", na.rm = TRUE))
      cat("Failed fits were excluded from model comparisons. Blank cells do not represent zero.\n")
    if (exists("use_scm") && use_scm)
      cat("The analysis model of this report already includes the kept effects",
          "(their sizes are in the parameter table above).\n")
  }
}
```

# 4. Steady-State Exposure from the EBEs

## 4.1 EBE Distributions and Correlation

```{r ebe-dist, fig.width=11, fig.height=7, fig.cap="Distributions and pairwise relationships of empirical Bayes estimates"}
ebe_long <- est$eta %>% pivot_longer(-ID, names_to = "ETA", values_to = "VALUE")
h_ebe <- ggplot(ebe_long, aes(VALUE)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ ETA, scales = "free") +
  labs(x = "EBE", y = "Count") + theme_bw()

eta_cols <- setdiff(names(est$eta), "ID")
if (length(eta_cols) >= 2) {
  pairs_ebe <- do.call(rbind, combn(eta_cols, 2, simplify = FALSE, function(cc)
    data.frame(PAIR = paste(cc[1], "vs", cc[2]),
               A = est$eta[[cc[1]]], B = est$eta[[cc[2]]])))
  s_ebe <- ggplot(pairs_ebe, aes(A, B)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 0.7, colour = "steelblue") +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, colour = "red") +
    facet_wrap(~ PAIR, scales = "free") +
    labs(x = "EBE (first of pair)", y = "EBE (second of pair)") + theme_bw()
  grid.arrange(h_ebe, s_ebe, nrow = 2)
} else {
  h_ebe
}
```

## 4.2 Steady-State Exposure

```{r ebe-exposure-sim, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
idat <- as.data.frame(est$eta)
idat$ID <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(as.character(idat$ID)))
if(anyNA(idat$ID)) stop("Exposure simulation requires numeric subject IDs")
update_cpp_covariates(CPP_EBE,fit,SCM_CPP_MAP)
mod_ebe <- pmx_report_update_model(mread(CPP_EBE,quiet=TRUE),est,residual=FALSE)
ebe_params <- names(param(mod_ebe))
ebe_source <- paste(readLines(CPP_EBE,warn=FALSE),collapse="\n")
eta_positions <- unique(as.integer(gsub("[^0-9]","",unlist(regmatches(ebe_source,gregexpr("ETA\\([0-9]+\\)",ebe_source))))))
ebe_names <- setdiff(names(idat),"ID")
if(length(eta_positions)) {
  if(max(eta_positions)!=length(ebe_names)) stop("Simulator ETA ordering/dimension differs from the fitted EBE; author the matching EBE simulator")
  idat[paste0("ETA",seq_along(ebe_names))] <- idat[ebe_names]
} else if(!all(tolower(ebe_names) %in% tolower(ebe_params))) stop("Simulator does not accept every fitted EBE as a parameter")
eta_source <- if(length(eta_positions)) "idata.all" else "omega"
captures <- c(PK="IPRED")
convert <- list(PK=function(x) pmx_natural(x,.report_ctl))
exposure_report <- pmx_fit_exposure(mod_ebe,idat,df,captures,convert,eta_source)
impact_cov <- pmx_fit_baseline_view(df,c("SEX","RACE","AGE","BW","BMI","ALB","CRCL"))
expo_long <- exposure_report$values %>% left_join(impact_cov,by="ID")

impact_reference <- impact_cov[impact_cov$ID %in% exposure_report$values$ID,,drop=FALSE]
expo_long <- expo_long %>% mutate(
  AGE_G  = pmx_fit_impact_groups("AGE",AGE,impact_reference$AGE),
  BMI_G  = pmx_fit_impact_groups("BMI",BMI,impact_reference$BMI),
  CRCL_G = pmx_fit_impact_groups("CRCL",CRCL,impact_reference$CRCL),
  BW_G   = pmx_fit_impact_groups("BW",BW,impact_reference$BW),
  ALB_G  = pmx_fit_impact_groups("ALB",ALB,impact_reference$ALB),
  SEX_G = pmx_fit_category_group("SEX",SEX),
  RACE_G = pmx_fit_category_group("RACE",RACE))

EXPO_YLAB <- "Drug concentration (ng/mL)"
EXPO_XLAB <- stats::setNames(var_labels[c("SEX","RACE","AGE","BW","BMI","ALB","CRCL")],
  c("SEX_G","RACE_G","AGE_G","BW_G","BMI_G","ALB_G","CRCL_G"))
EXPO_SECTION <- c(SEX_G="5.6.1 Sex",RACE_G="5.6.2 Race",
  AGE_G="5.6.3 Age",BW_G="5.6.4 Body weight",BMI_G="5.6.5 BMI",ALB_G="5.6.6 Albumin",
  CRCL_G="5.6.7 Renal function (creatinine clearance)")
EXPO_PLOTS <- pmx_fit_covariate_figures(expo_long,EXPO_SECTION,EXPO_XLAB,
  roles=c(PK="PK exposure"),ylabels=c(PK=EXPO_YLAB))
```

## 4.3 Impact of Covariates

```{r covariate-impact, results='asis', fig.show='asis', fig.width=9, fig.height=if(length(EXPO_PLOTS)) vapply(EXPO_PLOTS,`[[`,0,"height") else 4.5, fig.cap=vapply(EXPO_PLOTS,`[[`,"","caption")}
pmx_fit_show_covariate_figures(EXPO_PLOTS,EXPO_SECTION,EXPO_XLAB,fit_result_text)

## 5.2 Individual Fits (Sample)

```{r indiv-fits, fig.width=10, fig.height=8, fig.cap="Individual observed and fitted PK profiles. Blue: individual predictions. Red: population predictions."}
aug <- est$aug
set.seed(123)
sample_ids <- sample_subjects(aug$ID)
aug_sample <- aug %>% filter(ID %in% sample_ids)

ggplot(aug_sample, aes(TIME, DV)) +
  geom_point(color = "black", size = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = IPRED), color = "blue", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_line(aes(y = PRED), color = "red", linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~ ID, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Time (h)", y = "Concentration (ng/mL)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

## 5.3 VPC (Visual Predictive Check)

```{r vpc, eval=RUN_VPC, fig.width=9, fig.height=9, fig.cap="Visual predictive check of PK concentrations"}
require_vpc_contract(CPP_SIM,"DV")
update_cpp_covariates(CPP_SIM, fit, SCM_CPP_MAP)

mod_sim <- pmx_report_update_model(mread(CPP_SIM),est)

sim_data <- df %>%
  transmute(ID, time = TIME, evid = EVID, amt = AMT, cmt = CMT, mdv = MDV)
for(v in intersect(c("RATE","II","ADDL","SS"),names(df))) sim_data[[tolower(v)]] <- df[[v]]
sim_data <- pmx_sim_covariates(mod_sim,sim_data,df,scm_cov,names(est$fixef))

vpc_pop <- mod_sim %>% mrgsolve::zero_re() %>% data_set(sim_data) %>%
  carry_out(evid, cmt, mdv) %>%
  mrgsim(end = -1, outvars = "IPRED") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% filter(evid == 0, mdv == 0) %>%
  transmute(ID = as.character(ID), time, POP_PRED = IPRED)
vpc_pop <- unique_prediction(vpc_pop,c("ID","time"))

.vpc_ctl <- if (!is.null(frozen_search$ctl)) frozen_search$ctl else character()
vpc_obs_df <- df %>% filter(EVID == 0, MDV == 0) %>%
  select(ID, time = TIME, DV) %>% arrange(ID, time)

aug_pred <- observation_aug(est$aug) %>%
  filter(!is.na(PRED)) %>%
  transmute(ID = as.character(ID), time = TIME, PRED)
aug_pred <- unique_prediction(aug_pred,c("ID","time"))

vpc_obs_df <- vpc_obs_df %>%
  mutate(ID_chr = as.character(ID)) %>%
  left_join(aug_pred, by = c("ID_chr" = "ID", "time")) %>%
  select(-ID_chr)
if (anyNA(vpc_obs_df$PRED))
  stop(sprintf("PCVPC: %d observed records have no PRED in est$aug",
               sum(is.na(vpc_obs_df$PRED))))

# Validate once before spending the VPC simulation budget; a strict reference never refits.
pmx_sim_prediction_check(aug_pred,transform(vpc_pop,POP_PRED=pmx_natural(POP_PRED,.vpc_ctl)),keys=c("ID","time"),tag="VPC ppk",
  reference=function() pmx_native_population(fit,convert=function(value,endpoint) pmx_natural(value,.vpc_ctl)),diagnostics=file.path("table","_simulator_validation.json"))
vpc_obs_df <- pmx_vpc_population(vpc_obs_df,transform(vpc_pop,POP_PRED=pmx_natural(POP_PRED,.vpc_ctl)),keys=c("ID","time"))

set.seed(666666)
vpc_sim <- lapply(seq_len(VPC_NSIM), function(i) {
  mod_sim %>%
    data_set(sim_data) %>%
    carry_out(evid, cmt, mdv) %>%
    mrgsim(end = -1, outvars = c("IPRED", "DV")) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    mutate(rep = i)
}) %>% bind_rows()

vpc_sim <- vpc_sim %>% filter(evid == 0, mdv == 0) %>%
  mutate(ID_chr = as.character(ID)) %>%
  left_join(vpc_pop, by = c("ID_chr" = "ID", "time")) %>%
  select(-ID_chr) %>%
  transmute(ID, time, IPRED = pmx_natural(DV, .vpc_ctl), PRED = pmx_natural(POP_PRED, .vpc_ctl), rep) %>% arrange(rep, ID, time)
if (anyNA(vpc_sim$PRED))
  stop("VPC: a simulated record has no population prediction")


pmx_vpc_records(vpc_obs_df,vpc_sim,VPC_NSIM)

vpc <- observed(vpc_obs_df, x = time, y = DV) %>%
  simulated(vpc_sim, y = IPRED) %>%
  binning(bin = "jenks", nbins = 12) %>%
  vpcstats(qpred = c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95))

vpc_panels(plot(vpc), "Concentration (ng/mL)")
```

```{r simulator-validation-note, results='asis'}
for(note in pmx_fit_simulator_note()) cat(note,"\n\n")
```

```{r pcvpc, eval=RUN_VPC, fig.width=9, fig.height=9, fig.cap="Prediction-corrected visual predictive check of PK concentrations"}
pcvpc <- observed(vpc_obs_df, x = time, y = DV) %>%
  simulated(vpc_sim, y = IPRED) %>%
  binning(bin = "jenks", nbins = 14) %>%
  predcorrect(pred = PRED) %>%
  vpcstats(qpred = c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95))

vpc_panels(
  plot(pcvpc) +
    geom_point(data = as.data.frame(pcvpc$obs), aes(x = x, y = ypc),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, shape = 1, colour = "grey25",
    size = 1, alpha = 0.35)
  , "Prediction-corrected concentration (ng/mL)")
```
